start_message:
🔥 MediaSave

Hi!

Send me a link to a video, image, or other supported media content.

I'll try to download it and send it back to you.

Supported platforms:
📸 Instagram
▶️ YouTube
👻 Snapchat
🎮 Likee
📌 Pinterest
🧵 Threads
unsupported_platform: ⚠️ This platform is not supported yet.
content_protected: 🔒 Content is protected or unavailable for download.
file_too_large: 📦 File is too large to send via Telegram.
download_timeout: ⏱ Download took too long. Please try again.
download_error: ❌ Failed to process URL. Please check the URL and try again.
queue_full: 🚫 Queue is full. Please try later.
rate_limited: ⏳ Too many requests. Please wait a bit.
admin_broadcast_prompt: Send a message to broadcast to all users.
cut_prompt:
✂️ Enter start and end time in HH:MM:SS format
Example: 00:05 00:20
cut_invalid_range: ❌ Start must be before end and within video duration.
help_text: Send me a link to a video or image from a supported platform, and I'll save it for you.
platform_blocked: ⚠️ The platform blocked the connection. Try another link or retry later.
music_search_prompt: 🔍 Send a track name or artist to search.
music_search_error: ❌ Search failed. Please try again later.
